note: Measured, not authored: the articulation order the observation and the action actually use, keyed by the asset it was measured on. This is NOT the recipe's joint_order -- that one is the URDF tree order, asserted against the URDF by export_ue.py and shipped to UE. The two are different facts and nothing requires them to be equal; what matters is that this one is written down, because a permutation here silently misaligns every trained checkpoint and the run records used to say nothing about it. Re-measure after an asset change: python rl_exp/tools/verify/obs_protocol_live.py --headless --tasks <task> --pin --reason '<why>'.
